scope: Cold home on a Linux desktop Chromium headless shell. Same 1024 × 768 viewport, id-ID locale and default preferences. Fresh browser storage per sample, same server implementation for all builds. No input, network throttling or field measurements.
cause: Only the pre-correction home replaced its settled view on first service-worker controllerchange. The brief loading view brought the footer into view and removed it again. The connected home has no package-dependent status; it now listens to connectivity changes, and subscribes to install/controller events when displaying an offline-dependent action.

regression_on_faulty_candidate.outcome: Expected failure on the pre-correction source. Final catalog-offline-v151 receipts require a retained home in all engines.

sources.observer: PerformanceObserver layout-shift, buffered; exclude hadRecentInput. Record source node and pre/post y. MutationObserver assigns IDs to successive .app-view elements and records aria-busy and h1. The worker controllerchange is timestamped in the same document clock.
